content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Soft-structure silk-blend blouse with a relaxed collar, loose fit, mid-length hitting at the hip, deep emerald green (#024e3e), smooth satin finish. High-waisted pleated midi skirt in drapey viscose, A-line silhouette falling to just below the knee, charcoal grey (#36454F), fluid woven fabric that resists wrinkling. Chunky leather ankle boots with a low block heel and a waterproof rubber toe cap, rounded toe, chestnut brown (#8B4513), durable nubuck leather with sealed seams. This outfit works because the rich emerald green flatters her warm skin tone while remaining sophisticated enough for an evening date at a casual restaurant. The pleated skirt offers graceful movement without restricting leg mobility, ensuring comfort if she needs to navigate possible rain or sit for long periods. Waterproofing details on the boots address her worry about moisture without sacrificing style, perfectly balancing her need to look polished with the reality of autumn weather."}
